description: Generates a static HTML website from a managed Visual Studio solution that allows you to search, browse and navigate the C#, VB, MSBuild and TypeScript code online. 💜 A continuation of Kirill Osenkov's SourceBrowser (https://github.com/KirillOsenkov/SourceBrowser), now archived, with thanks to Kirill and everyone who contributed to the original.
summary: Generates a website to browse a managed code solution online
title: SourceBrowser
